content: विस्फूर्जथुः .²1 Roaring, thundering, rumbling. .²2 A clap or peal of thunder. .²3 (Hence) A thunderlike manifestation or rise, any sudden appearance or stroke; ममैव जन्मान्तरपातकानां विपाकविस्फूर्जथुरप्रसह्यः <ls>R. 14. 62</ls>. .²4 Rolling. (as of waves); swell, surging appearance; महोर्मिविस्फूर्जथुनिर्विशेषाः <ls>R. 13. 12</ls>.
